windows.description: Windows CTest runs: the windows-msvc CI job (ci preset) and any local run validated with tools/linux_test_report.py --gate windows.
windows.label: required

allowSkip.layerc_overlay_tests: the runner cannot create an isolated desktop; unavailable interactive coverage, not a pass

linux-headless.description: Display-free Linux suites (tools/run-linux-tests.sh, CTest label headless).
linux-headless.label: headless

optional.layerc_benchmark_result_tests: registered only where pwsh is installed; PowerShell is not a Linux build dependency
optional.layerc_linux_wayland_connection_tests: registered only with the optional wayland-client transport; private failure fixtures, no desktop required
optional.layerc_linux_wayland_registry_tests: registered only with wayland-client and test-only wayland-server; private protocol server, no desktop required
optional.layerc_linux_wayland_paint_tests: registered only with the native Wayland lane (scanner, protocols, cairo, xkbcommon); pure painter, no compositor required
optional.layerc_linux_wayland_keymap_tests: registered only with the native Wayland lane and test-only wayland-server; private seat server, no desktop required

linux-x11.description: Linux suites that need an X display (Xvfb in CI, CTest label x11).
linux-x11.label: x11

optional.layerc_linux_wayland_xwayland_loss_tests: registered with X11, wayland-client and test-only wayland-server; forced Wayland loss must drain unselected XWayland work

linux-wayland.description: Native Wayland providers inside a disposable headless sway session (tools/wayland-test-session.sh, CTest label wayland); registered with the native Wayland lane (TARGET layerc_wayland), independently of X11.
linux-wayland.label: wayland

linux-editor.description: Linux LayerE toolkit suites under an X display (CTest label editor); selected by tools/run-linux-tests.sh --editor.
linux-editor.label: editor

linux-dbus.description: Isolated session-bus fakes (fake Shell1/KWin, GNOME bridge, portal consent, daemon provider precedence and idle quiescence); registered with the optional sd-bus lane (libsystemd or libelogind) and selected only where it is built (CTest label dbus).
linux-dbus.label: dbus

optional.layerc_linux_pipewire_capture_tests: registered only with sd-bus and PipeWire; private remote lifecycle, fd/thread counts, and version faults

allowSkip.layerc_linux_dbus_service_tests: dbus-run-session missing; unavailable fake-bus coverage, not a pass
allowSkip.layerc_linux_gnome_bridge_tests: dbus-run-session missing; unavailable fake-bus coverage, not a pass
allowSkip.layerc_linux_portal_screencast_tests: dbus-run-session missing; unavailable fake-bus coverage, not a pass
allowSkip.layerc_linux_bus_providers_tests: dbus-run-session missing; unavailable fake-bus coverage, not a pass

linux-gjs.description: JavaScript fixtures (CTest label gjs): the KWin script and the GNOME Shell extension (pure modules, glue on a private dbus-run-session bus, network boundary, datadir install).
linux-gjs.label: gjs

allowSkip.layerc_linux_kwin_script_tests: gjs missing; unavailable script coverage, not a pass
allowSkip.layerc_linux_gnome_extension_report_test: gjs missing; unavailable script coverage, not a pass
allowSkip.layerc_linux_gnome_extension_overlay_tes: gjs missing; unavailable script coverage, not a pass
allowSkip.layerc_linux_gnome_extension_network_tes: gjs missing; unavailable script coverage, not a pass
allowSkip.layerc_linux_gnome_extension_shell_tests: gjs or dbus-run-session missing; unavailable extension glue coverage, not a pass
